takes.sourceDescription: walk
takes.title: Walk Forward with Easy Arm Swings
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins in a stride, takes even forward steps with relaxed arms, and slows slightly near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up and down, hop on one foot
takes.title: Repeat Vertical Jumps and One-Foot Hops
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright jumps, knee lifts, and short one-foot hops. The take ends in a very low wide squat.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up and down, hop on one foot
takes.title: Jump and Hop, Then Walk Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, repeats jumps and high-knee hops, and returns to regular steps before the end.

takes.sourceDescription: run, leap
takes.title: Run into a Broad Leap
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes several running steps, stretches both arms outward during a long airborne stride, and lands into another running step.

takes.sourceDescription: run, leap
takes.title: Leap with Both Arms Spread and Resume Running
takes.actionDescription: The performer runs into a quick leap with the arms out and legs apart, then lands and runs through the final frame.

takes.sourceDescription: cartwheel
takes.title: Cartwheel and Return to Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, tips sideways to bring the hands down, and passes through an inverted split-leg position. They recover upright in a narrow stance.

takes.sourceDescription: cartwheels
takes.title: Perform Two Cartwheels
takes.actionDescription: The performer tips sideways into a cartwheel, returns briefly to standing, and repeats the inversion. They finish upright with arms low.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - arms held high, side arabesque
takes.title: Raise Both Arms and Hold a Side Extension
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, takes a small step, raises both arms overhead and extends one leg sideways. They sustain the shape through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - fold in from side arabesque, curl inwards
takes.title: Fold Inward from a Raised-Arm Dance Pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with the arms raised and one foot out, then curls the chest and head forward, bringing the arms in. They hold the folded shape through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - fold in from side arabesque, curl inwards
takes.title: Curl Inward and Hold the Fold
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one foot out and arms raised, then brings the arms inward and drops the head and shoulders. The folded pose holds through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - lean forward, bring back leg forward, arching arms
takes.title: Bring the Back Leg Forward and Hold Open Elbows
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with both arms up, leans forward and brings the lifted leg through, then holds a bent-knee stance with the elbows open.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - fold in from side arabesque, curl inwards
takes.title: Fold Inward from an Open Dance Pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with an open, high-arm shape, lowers the arms and curls the upper body forward. They end with the elbows tucked and head lowered.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - lean forward, bring back leg forward, arching arms
takes.title: Bring the Back Leg Forward with Arcing Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both arms high, then lowers the arms as the torso leans and the lifted leg moves forward. The take ends leaning forward with both elbows open.

takes.sourceDescription: static dance pose - folded in, head lowered, leg bent
takes.title: Hold a Folded Dance Pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a folded upper-body position with the head lowered and one leg bent. Only small shifts occur across the take.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - fold in from side arabesque, curl inwards
takes.title: Lower the Arms and Curl Forward from a Side Extension
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both arms down from overhead and gathers them as the head and upper body fold inward. The final position stays narrow and bent.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - lean forward, bring back leg forward, arching arms
takes.title: Lean Forward and Arc Both Arms Outward
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with raised arms, brings the back leg forward, and folds slightly as both elbows sweep out. They hold that shape at the end.

takes.sourceDescription: balance on one leg, outstretched arms
takes.title: Raise a Knee into a Sustained One-Leg Balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers the arms from overhead, raises one knee, and holds the balance with both arms extended sideways through the final frame.

takes.sourceDescription: balance on one leg, outstretched arms
takes.title: Hold a Knee-Up Balance with Arms Spread
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves from an open high-arm stance into a one-leg balance, extends both arms outward and maintains the raised knee through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: acrobatics - spin/twirl, hang on ropes
takes.title: Twirl in a Hanging Pose with Repeated Leg Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly turns with one or both arms raised, changing from tucked knees to legs stretched sideways. The CMU source identifies a rope apparatus.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - lean back on bent leg, balance, bend elbow by ear
takes.title: Lean Back into a Sustained Dance Balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms raised, bends the supporting leg, and leans back with the forearms gathered near the head. They hold the backward-leaning shape through the end.
